98:- **FR-001**: The system MUST wire the search bar already present on "Meus Registros" to `GET /entries/search`'s `q` parameter, returning entries ranked by semantic similarity to the typed term rather than by exact keyword matching.
99:- **FR-002**: Text entered in the search bar MUST be debounced at the fixed 300 ms parameter (requirements section 10), so that a burst of fast typing results in exactly one search request fired after the user pauses, never one request per keystroke; clearing the search text to empty MUST NOT itself trigger a search-for-nothing request.
100:- **FR-003**: The system MUST provide a filter sheet, reachable via the existing funnel button, offering a single-choice date-range selector (Todo o período / Esta semana / Este mês, mapped to `dateFrom`/`dateTo`) and a multi-select entry-type selector (manual, áudio, foto, chat, mapped to `source`), with "Aplicar" committing the current selections and "Limpar" resetting the sheet's own selections before they are applied. Because `source` accepts only a single value per request, selecting more than one entry-type chip MUST be implemented as one request per selected type, with the responses merged, de-duplicated by entry ID, and re-sorted before being rendered (see Clarifications).
101:- **FR-004**: The filter sheet's "CATEGORIA" chip group (trabalho, rotina, descanso, relações) MUST be rendered for visual fidelity to the prototype but MUST NOT filter the result list or send any category-related parameter to the backend, since neither `GET /entries` nor `GET /entries/search` implements a category or tag filter.
102:- **FR-005**: Any combination of currently active criteria — date range, the set of selected entry types, and an active search term — MUST narrow the result list using AND logic across those three axes at once, never OR logic between them. Within the entry-type axis itself, selecting more than one type MUST include an entry if it matches ANY of the selected types (OR among types), since each entry has exactly one `source` value and could otherwise never satisfy more than one type at a time.
103:- **FR-005a**: A new search, filter change, or clear action MUST be treated as superseding any still-in-flight earlier request for the same screen: the response of an earlier, now-superseded request MUST be discarded rather than applied, so a slower stale response can never overwrite the results of a more recent request.
104:- **FR-005b**: While an active search term (`q`) is in effect, the result list MUST consist of the single bounded response already returned by `GET /entries/search` (up to its `limit`); scrolling within that list MUST NOT trigger a further fetch. Clearing the search term MUST resume `GET /entries`'s existing cursor-based infinite scroll (RF07) for filter-only or unfiltered browsing.
105:- **FR-006**: Whenever one or more filters are applied, the screen MUST show a removable chip for each active filter under the search bar, a "Limpar filtros" link, and the funnel button in its filled/active visual state.
106:- **FR-007**: Removing a single active-filter chip MUST drop only that criterion and refresh the result list accordingly; activating "Limpar filtros" MUST drop every active filter and any active search text at once; neither action MUST reload or restart the screen.
107:- **FR-008**: Clearing every active filter and search term MUST return the screen to the same full, unfiltered entry list RF07 already renders, without navigating away from or restarting "Meus Registros".
108:- **FR-009**: When an active search and/or filter combination matches zero entries on an account that has entries, the screen MUST show a distinct "no results" state separate from RF07's account-wide zero-entries empty state, with a way to adjust or clear the applied criteria.
109:- **FR-010**: Whenever a search or filtered fetch fails outright — whether because the device is offline, the request times out, or the response is malformed — the screen MUST continue showing whatever search/filter results are already present in the local cache rather than discarding them, and MUST present a clear, retryable error. Specifically for the offline case, upon reconnection the system MUST reconcile the displayed results with what the server currently returns for the same criteria without duplicating any entry.
110:- **FR-011**: This unit MUST NOT implement entry tag or category creation, editing, or filtering (extension feature, requirements section 2), export (RF05), chat (RF04), or any other later-unit behavior; and MUST NOT modify the backend, its API contract, or its configuration in any way.
132:- This unit makes live the search bar and funnel button that RF07 already renders as visual-fidelity placeholders on "Meus Registros" (per RF07's own FR-008 and its Assumptions), rather than building new UI chrome for them.

This is the only reading under which RF01 alone satisfies its own stated acceptance criterion that all three modalities "result in the same persisted-entry format," since entries are immutable (no `PATCH`/`DELETE /entries/:id`) and therefore cannot be corrected after creation — recognition must happen before the entry exists. (Resolved by technical judgment per user direction, applying Constitution Principle I, where the input docs are silent on this exact boundary.)
specs/003-multimodal-capture/spec.md:82:2. **Given** an in-progress audio recording, **When** the user closes the modal or stops without confirming save, **Then** no entry is created and no partially-recorded audio is persisted as an entry.

On return (after a mere backgrounding, the modal resumes normally; after a kill, the modal reopens to its default empty state), and if the content was lost to a process kill, the user must recapture rather than retry.
specs/003-multimodal-capture/spec.md:105:- **FR-006**: Confirming Save on any modality MUST result in exactly one persisted journal entry, created through the entry-creation endpoint, carrying the content appropriate to that modality and the correct origin (`manual` for text, `audio` for audio, `photo` for photo) — never a chat message. This guarantee MUST hold even if the user triggers Save/stop/picker-confirm more than once in quick succession for the same capture (e.g., a double tap): the system MUST ignore any such trigger received while a save for that capture is already in flight, so at most one entry is ever created per confirmed capture.
specs/003-multimodal-capture/spec.md:116:- **Journal Entry**: A persisted record with text content, an origin (`manual`, `audio`, or `photo` for this unit), and a creation time; structurally identical regardless of which modality produced it, and immutable once created.
specs/003-multimodal-capture/spec.md:117:- **Capture Session**: Ephemeral, device-only state that exists only while the Insertion Modal is open — which tab is active, any in-progress recording or selected image, and text recognized but not yet saved. specs/004-stt-ocr-processing/spec.md:16:- Q: The prototype's "Foto — Erro" state offers "Salvar só a foto," which saves the record "even without extracted text" (§4). The backend never persists the photo itself (`POST /media/ocr` summary: "the image is never persisted") and `POST /entries` requires `content` with `minLength: 1` — so what content does that saved entry actually carry? → A: A fixed, non-empty placeholder string (not the empty string, which the backend contract forbids) is sent as `content`, with `source: "photo"`; no later OCR attempt is made for that capture once this action is taken. 148:## R7 — Why "offline shows cached results" needs no new code
149-
150-**Decision**: no `ConnectivityChecker` pre-check is added before `search()`/`list()` calls, and no new "is
151-this fetch's failure due to being offline" branch is added beyond the generic failure-preserving pattern
152-`_fetchNextPage` already established (keep `entries` as they were, surface the failure in a retryable, inline
153-banner — here, `criteriaLoadFailure` for a criteria-change fetch, mirroring `pageLoadFailure` for a next-page
154-fetch).
155-
156-**Rationale**: FR-010 ("while offline, continue showing results already present in the local cache") is
157-satisfied by construction the same way RF07 already satisfies its own equivalent Edge Case — `RecordsLoaded`
158-is simply never replaced by a blank/loading state on a failed fetch; whatever was last successfully rendered
159-stays on screen. `ApiClient` already synthesizes `NetworkOfflineFailure` for a `DioException` with no response
160-(a real offline device), so the offline case reaches the exact same failure-preserving branch every other
161-network failure does — no special-casing needed. "Reconciles without duplicating any entry" (FR-010's second
162-half) is `EntryMerger`'s existing dedupe-by-ID behavior (`merge`/`mergeMany`), already guaranteed for any
163-successful refetch regardless of what triggered it.
164-
165-**Alternatives considered**: proactively checking `ConnectivityChecker.hasConnection()` before firing a
166-search/filter request (as `capture/`'s write-path use cases do) — rejected: those checks exist because a
167-*write* must never be attempted offline (RNF03/capture's own FR); a *read* has no such constraint, and RF07's
168-own `list()`/`getById()` never pre-check connectivity either — they let the HTTP client fail naturally and
169-handle the resulting `Either`. Introducing the check only for RF06's reads would be an inconsistency with
170-RF07's already-shipped, unmodified pattern for no stated benefit.

50:- Results from the local read cache stay consistent with the server after reconnection, without duplicating displayed items *(the architecture is cloud-only; offline allows only viewing already-cached data, not writing)*.

specs/003-multimodal-capture/spec.md:16:- Q: After a successful Save, the modal closes back to Home/Chat — but Home/Chat never renders journal entries (those appear only in the later "Meus Registros" unit, RF07). What should FR-011's "reflected in the app's state" actually look like on Home/Chat itself? → A: Nothing new is shown on Home/Chat. The prototype documents no confirmation screen, toast, or any other on-screen change for this flow, and inventing one would conflict with Principle IV's visual-fidelity constraint (faithfulness to a frozen prototype that defines no such state) as well as SC-003's "no required intermediate screens." "Reflected in the app's state" means only that the newly created entry is added to the app's local entries store/cache — the same store later units (e.g., RF07) will read from — not that Home/Chat's UI changes in any visible way. (Resolved by technical judgment per user direction, applying Constitution Principles I and IV, where the input docs are silent on this exact boundary.)

content.text:
Fixed. Root cause: `EntriesRepository.cachedEntries` was only ever populated by `create()` (an in-memory, process-lifetime list for optimistic just-created entries) — there was no actual on-device persisted cache of fetched entries, despite the PRD's requirement (requirements.md lines 50/125) that "Meus Registros" reads from a real local cache that survives a restart. So a cold app launch while already offline had nothing to fall back on, and `RecordsBloc` unconditionally showed the blank `RecordsLoadFailure` screen.

Changes:
- **[entries_local_cache.dart](lib/features/entries/data/entries_local_cache.dart)** (new) — persists entries to `flutter_secure_storage` (same pattern as `VaultSecureStorage`; journal content stays encrypted at rest like the PIN it's gated behind).
- **[entries_repository_impl.dart](lib/features/entries/data/entries_repository_impl.dart)** — `cachedEntries` now merges in the persisted cache (loaded once, race-safe) and is updated on every successful `create`/`list`/`search`, not just `create`.
- **[records_bloc.dart](lib/features/records/presentation/bloc/records_bloc.dart)** — on a cold-start fetch failure, falls back to the on-device cache if non-empty (shown with an inline retryable banner, matching the existing `pageLoadFailure` pattern already used for mid-session page failures), instead of the blank error screen. Empty cache still shows today's `RecordsLoadFailure`.

Fixed all five differences from the prototype:

1. **[filter_sheet.dart](lib/features/records/presentation/widgets/filter_sheet.dart)** — added the missing "Filtrar registros" title; renamed "INTERVALO DE DATA" → "PERÍODO"; capitalized entry-type labels (Manual/Áudio/Foto/Chat).
2. Same file — chips now use a `StadiumBorder` (fully rounded pill), unselected = transparent + light border (`colorBorder`) + gray text (`colorTextSecondary`), selected = `colorPrimary` fill + light text (`colorOnPrimary`); group labels switched to monospace gray (`textMonoCaption`).
3. **[active_filter_chips_row.dart](lib/features/records/presentation/widgets/active_filter_chips_row.dart)** — capitalized labels to match; chips now use the soft olive tint (`colorSecondary` @ 18%) with dark olive text (`#3F4A38`), 8px-rounded (matching the prototype, not a pill); row wrapped in `Align(centerLeft)` so it's left-aligned instead of centered; "Limpar filtros" switched to small gray monospace.
4. **[records_page.dart](lib/features/records/presentation/pages/records_page.dart)** — added the "Busca limitada ao que está salvo no aparelho." note under the search bar, shown whenever the current failure is `NetworkOfflineFailure`.
5. **[api_client.dart](lib/core/network/api_client.dart)** — root-caused the raw exception text: client-synthesized `NetworkTimeoutFailure`/`NetworkOfflineFailure` now always carry a fixed, friendly message instead of Dio's raw `e.message` (e.g. "Failed host lookup"), fixing this everywhere the failure surfaces, not just this screen.

Updated existing tests for the new labels/layout and added new coverage (offline-note visibility, non-offline-failure doesn't trigger it). All 332 tests pass, `flutter analyze` is clean.
